title: Corporate Travel Policy Amendment: Tier-1 City Rate Adjustments
content: Amendment to Section 4.2 (supersedes Travel Policy v1.2 for Tier-1 localities): Reflecting rising hospitality costs, the maximum daily meal allowance for business travel within designated Tier-1 high-cost metropolitan markets (including Chicago, New York City, San Francisco, and Boston) is raised to $100 per day. For all other non-Tier-1 domestic locations, the baseline rate remains subject to standard departmental guidelines.
